name: Maximum Carnage, Part 7: The Gathering Storm
title: The Amazing Spider-Man #379
desc: As the fight continues Shriek then uses her ability to command people to help defend them. Firestar then shoots a microwave beam at Carnage and he runs in fear, as Venom tries to get her to cook Carnage until he is dead. Firestar tried her best to block out everything Spider-man was saying and Venom was saying, but she stops right when Kasady was about to die. Venom is then furious and attacks Firestar, but Spider-man gets in his way so Venom smacks him away. Shortly after Carnage is fully healed and he then gets Shriek to use her Sonic bursts to defeat Venom. They later bring Venom off to find a place where they can torture him. While Spider-man then wakes up from being knocked unconscious from Venom's hit he sees Captain America reaching out a hand to help.
